verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              याज्ञसेन्या वचः श्रुत्वा पुनरेवार्जुनोऽब्रवीत् । अनुमान्य महाबाहुं ज्येष्ठं भ्रातरमच्युतम् ॥१॥
verses.english: Bhrigu said Brahman first created a few Brahmanas who passed by the name of Prajapatis (lord of creation). Effulgent like the fire or the Sun, they were created out of the energy of that First-born Being.

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच । दण्डः शास्ति प्रजाः सर्वा दण्ड एवाभिरक्षति । दण्डः सुप्तेषु जागर्ति दण्डं धर्मं विदुर्बुधाः ॥२॥
verses.english: The powerful Lord then created Truth, Duty, Penance, the eternal Vedas, all sorts of pious deeds, and Purity, for enabling creatures to acquire heaven (by practising them).
verses.bhavadeepa: याज्ञसेन्या वच इति ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: दण्डः संरक्षते धर्मं तथैवार्थं जनाधिप । कामं संरक्षते दण्डस्त्रिवर्गो दण्ड उच्यते ॥३॥
verses.english: After this, the gods and the Danavas, the Gandharvas, the Daityas, the Asuras, the great snakes, the Yakshas, the Rakshasas, the Serpents, the Pishachas, and mankind with their four divisions, viz., Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas, and Shudras, O foremost of twice-born ones, and all the other orders of creatures, were created.
verses.bhavadeepa: नादण्डः क्षत्रियो भातीति द्रौपद्युक्तिमुपबृंहयति- दण्ड इति ॥२॥

verses.sanskrit: दण्डेन रक्ष्यते धान्यं धनं दण्डेन रक्ष्यते । एवं विद्वन्नुपाधत्स्व भावं पश्यस्व लौकिकम् ॥४॥
verses.english: The complexion of the Brahmanas was white; that of the Kshatriyas was red; that of the Vaishyas yellow; and that of the Shudras was black.

verses.sanskrit: राजदण्डभयादेके पापाः पापं न कुर्वते । यमदण्डभयादेके परलोकभयादपि ॥५॥
verses.english: Bharadwaja said If the distinction between the four castes be made by means only of colour, then it seems that all the four orders have been intermixed.
verses.bhavadeepa: उपाधत्स्व दण्डमिति शेषः । लौकिकं भावं लोकव्यवहारं पश्यस्व पश्य । यद्वा शोभनश्चासावलौकिकश्च तं भावं शास्त्रैकगम्यमानन्दात्मानमन्तर्दृष्ट्या पश्य बहिश्च दण्डमुपाधत्स्व । तेन सहदेवोक्तोऽर्थः प्रदर्शितो भवति ॥४॥

verses.sanskrit: परस्परभयादेके पापाः पापं न कुर्वते । एवं सांसिद्धिके लोके सर्वं दण्डे प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥६॥
verses.english: Lust, anger, fear, cupidity, grief, anxiety, hunger, exhaustion, possess and prevail over all men. How can men be distinguished by the attributes?

verses.sanskrit: दण्डस्यैव भयादेके न खाद‌न्ति परस्परम् । अन्धे तमसि मज्जेयुर्यदि दण्डो न पालयेत् ॥७॥
verses.english: The bodies of all men sweat and puss urine, faeces, phlegm, bile and blood. How then can men be divided into classes?
verses.bhavadeepa: सांसिद्धिके पशुवत् दण्डार्हस्वभावे ॥६॥

verses.sanskrit: यस्मा‌ददान्तान् दमयत्यशिष्टान् दण्डयत्यपि । दमनाद्दण्डनाच्चैव तस्माद्दण्डं विदुर्बुधाः ॥८॥
verses.english: Mobile objects are endless in number; the immobile objects are also innumerable. How then can so many different objects be divided into classes?

verses.sanskrit: वाचा दण्डो ब्राह्मणानां क्षत्रियाणां भुजार्पणम् । दानदण्डाः स्मृता वैश्या निर्दण्डः शूद्र उच्यते ॥९॥
verses.english: Bhrigu said There is in fact no distinction between the different castes. The whole world at first consisted of Brahmanas. Created equally by Brahman, men have, on account of their acts, been divided into various castes.
verses.bhavadeepa: दण्डशब्दार्थमाह- यस्मादिति । दमयति ताडनादिना दण्डयति वित्तमपहरति ॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: असंमोहाय मर्त्यानामर्थसंरक्षणाय च । मर्यादा स्थापिता लोके दण्डसंज्ञा विशांपते ॥१०॥
verses.english: They who found excessive pleasure in enjoyment become possessed of the attributes of harshness and anger, endued with courage, and were unmindful of the works of piety and worship,-those Brahmanas possessing the quality of Darkness, became Kshatriyas.
verses.bhavadeepa: भुज्यत इति भुजं भक्तं तन्मात्रार्पणं वेतनप्रदानमित्यर्थः । दानं राज्ञे द्रव्यार्पणम् । निर्दण्डः दास्यमेव कारयेन्न त्वस्य दण्डोऽस्ति । शूद्रं तु कारयेद्दास्यमिति मनूक्तेः । एतच्चाल्पापराधे ज्ञेयम् ॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: यत्र श्यामो लोहिताक्षो दण्डश्चरति सूद्यतः । प्रजास्तत्र न मुह्यन्ते नेता चेत्साधु पश्यति ॥११॥
verses.english: Those Brahmanas again who, unmindful of the duties laid down for them, became endued with both the qualities of Goodness and Darkness, and follow the professions of cattletending and agriculture, became Vaishyas.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मचारी गृहस्यश्च वानप्रस्थश्च भिक्षुकः । दण्डस्यैव भयादेते मनुष्या वर्त्मनि स्थिताः ॥१२॥
verses.english: Those Brahmanas again who were given to untruth and injuring other creatures possessed of cupidity, performed all sorts of works for their maintenance and had no purity of behaviour, and thus possessed of the quality of Darkness, became Shudras.
verses.bhavadeepa: श्यामः दृढाभिघातेन दण्ड्यस्यांध्यजनकत्वात् । लोहिताक्षो दण्डयितुः क्रोधातिशयात् सूद्यतः सुतरामुद्यतः साधु यथापराधम् ॥११॥

verses.sanskrit: नाभीतो यजते राजन्नाभीतो दातुमिच्छति । नाभीतः पुरुषः कश्चित्समये स्थातुमिच्छति ॥१३॥
verses.english: Divided by these occupations, Brahınanas, falling away from their own order became members of the other three castes. All the four castes, therefore, have always the right to perform all pious rites and sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit: नाच्छित्त्वा परमर्माणि नाकृत्वा कर्म दुष्करम् । नाहत्वा मत्स्यघातीव प्राप्नोति महतीं श्रियम् ॥१४॥
verses.english: Thus were the four castes at first created equally by Brahman who ordained for all of them the observances described (in the Vedas). Cupidity alone brought about the fall of many, who were possessed by ignorance.

verses.sanskrit: नाघ्नतः कीर्तिरस्तीह न वित्तं न पुनः प्रजाः । इन्द्रो वृत्रवधेनैव महेन्द्रः समपद्यत ॥१५॥
verses.english: The Brahmanas are always devoted to the Brahma-scriptures and practising vows and restraints, are capable of understanding Brahima. Their penances, therefore, never prove fruitless.
verses.bhavadeepa: महतीम् इन्द्रलोकादिं मत्स्यघातीवेत्यनपकारिणामपि वधः कार्य इत्यत्र दृष्टान्तः ॥१४॥

verses.sanskrit: य एव देवा हन्तारस्ताँल्लोकोऽर्चयते भृशम् । हन्ता रुद्रस्तथा स्कन्दः शक्रोऽग्निर्वरुणो यमः ॥१६॥
verses.english: They amongst them are not Brahmanas who cannot understand that every created thing is Supreme Brahma. These, falling away, became members of various (inferior) castes.

verses.sanskrit: हन्ता कालस्तथा वायुर्मृत्युर्वैश्रवणो रविः । वसवो मरुतः साध्या विश्वेदेवाश्च भारत ॥१७॥
verses.english: Destitute of the light of knowledge, living a loose life of dissolution they are born as Pishas and Rakshasas and Ghosts, and as Mleccha tribes.

verses.sanskrit: एतान्देवान्नमस्यन्ति प्रतापप्रणता जनाः । न ब्रह्माणं न धातारं न पूषाणं कथञ्चन ॥१८॥
verses.english: The great Rishis who at the beginning were created (by Brahman's Will) afterwards themselves created, through their penances, men devoted to the duties laid down for them and rites laid down in the Eternal Vedas.

verses.sanskrit: मध्यस्थान्सर्वभूतेषु दान्ताञ्शमपरायणान् । जयन्ते मानवाः केचित्प्रशान्ताः सर्वकर्मसु ॥१९॥
verses.english: That other Creation, however, which is eternal and undecaying, which depends upon Brahma and has originated from the Primeval God, and which has Yoga for its support, is a mental one.

verses.sanskrit: न हि पश्यामि जीवन्तं लोके कञ्चिदहिंसया । सत्त्वैः सत्त्वा हि जीवन्ति दुर्बलैर्बलवत्तराः ॥२०॥
verses.english: I do not see any such creature in this world that supports life without doing any act of injury to others. Animals live upon animals, the stronger upon the weaker.

verses.sanskrit: नकुलो मूषिकानत्ति विडालो नकुलं तथा । बिडालमत्ति श्वा राजन् श्वानं व्यालमृगस्तथा ॥२१॥
verses.english: The mungoose eats up mice; the cat eats up inungoose; the dog eats up the cat; the dog again is devoured by the spotted leopard.

verses.sanskrit: तानत्ति पुरुषः सर्वान्पश्य कालो यथागतः । प्राणस्यान्नमिदं सर्वं जङ्गमं स्थावरं च यत् ॥२२॥
verses.english: Behold, all things again are eaten up by the Destroyer when he comes! This mobile and immobile universe is food for living creatures.
verses.bhavadeepa: व्यालमृगश्चित्रव्याघ्रः ॥२१॥

verses.sanskrit: विधानं दैवविहितं तत्र विद्वान्न मुह्यति । यथा सृष्टोऽसि राजेन्द्र तथा भवितुमर्हसि ॥२३॥
verses.english: This has been ordained by the celestials. The learned man, therefore, is never stupefied at it. You should, O great king, become what you are by birth!

verses.sanskrit: विनीतक्रोधहर्षा हि मन्दा वनमुपाश्रिताः। विना वधं न कुर्वन्ति तापसाः प्राणयापनम् ॥२४॥
verses.english: Only the foolish (Kshatriyas) controlling anger and joy, dwell in the woods. The very ascetics cannot maintain their lives without killing creatures.
verses.bhavadeepa: यथासृष्टः शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यमित्याद्युक्तस्वभावः क्षत्रियः सृष्टोऽसि धात्रा ॥२३॥

verses.sanskrit: उद‌के बहवः प्राणाः पृथिव्यां च फलेषु च । न च कश्चिन्न तान् हन्ति किमन्यत्प्राणयापनात् ॥२५॥
verses.english: Innumerable creature live in water, on earth and in fruits. It is not true that one does not kill them. What greater duty is there than supporting one's life?
verses.bhavadeepa: विनीतौ अपनीतौ क्रोधहर्षौ यैस्ते मन्दाः क्षत्रियाः ॥२४॥

verses.sanskrit: सूक्ष्मयोनीनि भूतानि तर्कगम्यानि कानिचित् । पक्ष्मणोऽपि निपातेन येषां स्यात्स्कन्धपर्ययः ॥२६॥
verses.english: There are many creatures that are so ininute that their existence is not perceptible. The falling of the eyelids even kills them.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रामान्निष्क्रम्य मुनयो विगतक्रोधमत्सराः । वने कुटुम्बधर्माणो दृश्यन्ते परिमोहिताः॥२७॥
verses.english: There are men who controlling anger and pride love like ascetics and abandoning villages and towns repair to the forests. Coming there, those men become so stupefied that they live like householder again.
verses.bhavadeepa: स्कन्धपर्ययः देहस्य विपर्ययः ॥२६॥

verses.sanskrit: भूमिं भित्त्वौषधीश्छित्त्वा वृक्षादीनण्डजान् पशून् । मनुष्यास्तन्वते यज्ञास्ते स्वर्गं प्राप्नुवन्ति च ॥२८॥
verses.english: Others living like householders and tilling the soil, uprooting herbs, cutting off trees and killing birds and animals celebrate sacrifices and at last attain to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: दण्डनीत्यां प्रणीतायां सर्वे सिद्ध्यन्त्युपक्रमाः । कौन्तेय सर्वभूतानां तत्र मे नास्ति संशयः ॥२९॥
verses.english: O son of Kunti, I am sure that the acts of all creatures become successful only when the policy of chastisement is properly applied.

verses.sanskrit: दण्डश्चैन्न भवेल्लोके विनश्येयुरिमाः प्रजाः । जले मत्स्यानिवाभक्ष्यन् दुर्बलान्बलवत्तराः ॥३०॥
verses.english: If chastisement were done away with in this word, creatures would soon be destroyed. Like fishes in the water, stronger animals devour the weaker.
verses.bhavadeepa: ततो दण्डयुक्ता नीतिर्दण्डनीतिस्तस्यां प्रणीतायां प्रवर्तितायाम् ॥२९॥

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं चेदं ब्रह्मणा पूर्वमुक्तं दण्डः प्रजा रक्षति साधु नीतः । पश्याग्नयश्च प्रतिशाम्य भीताः सन्तर्जिता दण्डभयाज्ज्वलन्ति ॥३१॥
verses.english: Formerly Brahman himself, said that chastisement, properly applied, maintains creatures. Behold, the very fires, when put out, blaze up again, in fright, when blown! This is owing to the fear of force.
verses.bhavadeepa: अभक्ष्यन् भक्षयेयुः ॥३०॥

verses.sanskrit: अन्धं तम इवेदं स्यान्न प्राज्ञायत किञ्चन । दण्डश्चेन्न भवेल्लोके विभजन् साध्वसाधुनी ॥३२॥
verses.english: If there were no chastisement in the world differentiating the good from the evil, the whole world would have been covered with sheer darkness and all things would have been unsettled.
verses.bhavadeepa: सन्तर्जिताः फूत्कारेण ॥३१॥

verses.sanskrit: येऽपि संभिन्नमर्यादा नास्तिका वेदनिन्दकाः । तेऽपि भोगाय कल्पन्ते दण्डेनाशु निपीडिताः ॥३३॥
verses.english: By chastisement the violators of laws, the atheists and scoffers of the Vedas, soon become disposed to observe rules and regulations.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वो दण्डजितो लोको दुर्लभो हि शुचिर्जनः । दण्डस्य हि भयाद्भीतो भोगायैव प्रवर्तते ॥३४॥
verses.english: Every one in this world is kept all right by chastisement. A person by nature pure and pious is rare. In fear of chastisement, man becomes disposed to observe rules and restrictions.
verses.bhavadeepa: भोगाय पालनाय मर्यादाया इति शेषः ॥३३॥

verses.sanskrit: चातुर्वर्ण्यप्रमोदाय सुनीतिनयनाय च । दण्डो विधात्रा विहितो धर्मार्थौ भुवि रक्षितुम् ॥३५॥
verses.english: Chastisement was introduced by the Creator himself for protecting Religion and Profit, for the happiness of all the four orders, and for making thein pious and humble.

verses.sanskrit: यदि दण्डान्न बिभ्येयुर्वयांसि श्वापदानि च । अद्युः पशून्मनुष्यांश्च यज्ञार्थानि हवींषि च ॥३६॥
verses.english: If there had been no fear of chastisement, then ravens and beasts of prey would have devoured all other animals and men and the clarified butter intended for sacrifices.
verses.bhavadeepa: सुनीतिनयनाय विनयप्रापणाय ॥३५॥

verses.sanskrit: न ब्रह्मचार्यधीयीत कल्याणीं न दुहेत गाम् । न कन्योद्वहनं गच्छेद्यदि दण्डो न पालयेत् ॥३७॥
verses.english: If chastisement did not keep up and protect (the world), then no body would have read the Vedas, nobody would have milked a milch cow, and no maiden would have married.

verses.sanskrit: विष्वग्लोपः प्रवर्तेत भिद्येरन्सर्वसेतवः । ममत्वं न प्रजानीयुर्यदि दण्डो न पालयेत् ॥३८॥
verses.english: If chastisement did not uphold and protect, then destruction and confusion would have prevailed everywhere and all restrictions would have disappeared, and the idea of property would have gone away.
verses.bhavadeepa: कल्याणीमपत्यवतीं न दुहेत लोकः । उद्वहनं न गच्छेत् किं तु व्यभिचरेदेव ॥३७॥

verses.sanskrit: न संवत्सरसत्राणि तिष्ठेयुरकुतोभयाः। विधिवद्दक्षिणावन्ति यदि दण्डो न पालयेत् ॥३९॥
verses.english: If chastisement did not uphold and protect, people could never duly celebrate annual sacrifices with profuse presents.
verses.bhavadeepa: विष्वग्लोपः सर्वोच्छेदः सेतवो मर्यादाः ममत्वं परिच्छिन्नं न जानीयुः सर्वः सर्वत्र ममत्वं कुर्यादित्यर्थः ॥३८॥

verses.sanskrit: चरेयुर्नाश्रमे धर्मं यथोक्तं विधिमाश्रिताः । न विद्यां प्राप्नुयात्कश्चिद्यदि दण्डो न पालयेत् ॥४०॥
verses.english: If chastisement did not uphold and protect, no one would observe the duties of his own order as sanctioned (in the scriptures), and no one would have succeeded in gaining knowledge.
verses.bhavadeepa: तिष्ठेयुरनुतिष्ठेयुः ॥३९॥

verses.sanskrit: न चोष्ट्रा न बलीवर्दा नाश्वाश्वतरगर्दभाः । युक्ता वहेयुर्यानानि यदि दण्डो न पालयेत् ॥४१॥
verses.english: If chastisement did not reign supreme, neither, nor asses, would, even if yoked thereto, would carry cars and carriages.
verses.bhavadeepa: आश्रिता आश्रमिणः ॥४०॥

verses.sanskrit: न प्रेष्या वचनं कुर्युर्न बाला जातु कर्हिचित् । न तिष्ठेद्युवती धर्मे यदि दण्डो न पालयेत् ॥४२॥
verses.english: All creatures depend upon chastisement. The learned, therefore, declare that chastisement is the root of all things. Upon chastisement rests the heaven that people seek, and upon il rests this world also.

verses.sanskrit: दण्डे स्थिताः प्रजाः सर्वा भयं दण्डे विदुर्बुधाः । दण्डे स्वर्गो मनुष्याणां लोकोऽयं सुप्रतिष्ठितः ॥४३॥
न तत्र कूटं पापं वा वञ्चना वाऽपि दृश्यते । यत्र दण्डः सुविहितश्चरत्यरिविनाशनः ॥४४॥
verses.english: No sin, no falsehood, and no wickedness, is to be seen there where foe-destroying chastisement is properly used.

verses.sanskrit: हविः श्वा प्रलिहेद्दृष्ट्वा दण्डश्चेन्नोद्यतो भवेत् । हरेत्काकः पुरोडाशं यदि इण्डो न पालयेत् ॥४५॥
verses.english: If the rod of chastisement be not taken up, the dog will lick the sacrificial butter. If that rod were not raised up, the crow also would take away the first (sacrificial) offering.

verses.sanskrit: यदीदं धर्मतो राज्यं विहितं यद्यधर्मतः । कार्यस्तत्र न शोको वै भुङ्क्ष्व भोगान् यजस्व च ॥४६॥
verses.english: Fairly or unfairly, this kingdom has not been gained by us. Our duty now is to give up grief. Do you, therefore, enjoy it and celebrate sacrifices!

verses.sanskrit: सुखेन धर्मं श्रीमन्तश्चरन्ति शुचिवाससः । संवर्षन्तः फलैर्दानैर्भुञ्जानाश्चान्नमुत्तमम् ॥४७॥
verses.english: Living with their dear wives the lucky men, cat good food, wear good clothes, and cheerfully acquire virtue by fruits and gifts.

verses.sanskrit: अर्थे सर्वे समारम्भाः समायत्ता न संशयः । स च दण्डे समायत्तः पश्य दण्डस्य गौरवम् ॥४८॥
verses.english: Forsooth, all our acts, depend on wealth : that wealth again depends on chastisement. Mark, therefore, the utility of chastisement!

verses.sanskrit: लोकयात्रार्थमेवेह धर्मप्रवचनं कृतम् । अहिंसाऽसाधुहिंसेति श्रेयान् धर्मपरिग्रहः ॥४९॥
verses.english: Duties have been laid down for maintaining the various relations of the world. There are two things here, viz., abstention from injury and injury done with righteous motives, Of these two, that which brings in righteousness is preferable.

verses.sanskrit: नात्यन्तं गुणवत्किञ्चिन्न चाप्यत्यन्तनिर्गुणम् । उभयं सर्वकार्येषु दृश्यते साध्वसाधु वा ॥५०॥
verses.english: There is no act that is entirely pure, nor any that is entirely simple. In all acts, right or wrong, something of both prevails.
verses.bhavadeepa: गोष्ठप्रविष्टव्याघ्रादेरहिंसा गवामेव हिंसा भवति । अत एतयोर्मध्ये धर्मस्य परिग्रह आर्तत्राणं श्रेयान् ॥४९॥

verses.sanskrit: पशूनां वृषणं छित्त्वा ततो भिन्दन्ति मस्तकम् । वहन्ति बहयो भारान्बध्नन्ति दमयन्ति च ॥५१॥
verses.english: Animals are castrated, and their horns are cut off. They are then compelled to carry weights are tethered, and beaten.

verses.sanskrit: एवं पर्याकुले लोके वितथैर्जर्जरीकृते । तैस्तैर्न्यायैर्महाराज पुराणं धर्ममाचर ॥५२॥
verses.english: In this world that is unsubstantial full of abuses and painful, O king, do you practise the old customs of men, following rules and examples quoted above.
verses.bhavadeepa: मस्तकं भिन्दन्ति श्रृङ्गवृद्धिर्माभूदिति । नस्तकानिति पाठे नासिकाः ॥५१॥

verses.sanskrit: यज, देहि, प्रजा रक्ष, धर्मं समनुपालय । अमित्राञ्जहि कौन्तेय, मित्राणि परिपालय ॥५३॥
verses.english: Celebrate sacrifices, distribute alms, protect your subjects, and practise righteousness. Kill your enemies, O son of Kunti, and protect your friends.
verses.bhavadeepa: जर्जरीकृते दण्डेन तदभावे भारवहनादि कार्यं न स्यादतः पुराणमेव धर्ममाचर । न त्वत्र प्रवाहायातं हिंसादिदोषमवेक्षस्वेति भावः ॥५२॥

verses.sanskrit: मा च ते निघ्नतः शत्रून् मन्युर्भवतु पार्थिव । न तत्र किल्बिषं किञ्चित्कर्तुर्भवति भारत ॥५४॥
verses.english: Be not dispirited. O king, while killing enemies! He that does it, О Bharata, does not commit the slightest sin!

verses.sanskrit: आततायी हि यो हन्यादाततायिनमागतम् । न तेन भ्रूणहा स स्यान्मन्युस्तं मन्युमार्च्छति ॥५५॥
verses.english: He who takes up a weapon and kills an arined enemy advancing against him, does not incur the sin of killing a man, for it is the anger of the advancing enemy that excites the anger of the destroyer.

verses.sanskrit: अवध्यः सर्वभूतानामन्तरात्मा न संशयः । अवध्ये चात्मानि कथं वध्यो भवति कस्यचित् । यथा हि पुरुषः शालां पुनः सम्प्रविशेन्नवाम् ॥५६॥
verses.english: The soul of every creature cannot be killed. When the soul cannot be killed how then can one be killed by another?
verses.bhavadeepa: आततायी शस्त्रपाणिः मन्युः क्रोधः मन्युं क्रोधमार्छति आ सर्वतः ऋच्छति प्राप्नोति ‘मन्युः कर्ता नाहं कर्ता’ इति श्रुतेस्तत्र न भ्रूणहा भवतीत्यर्थः ॥५५॥

verses.sanskrit: एवं जीवः शरीराणि तानि तानि प्रपद्यते ॥५७॥
verses.english: As a person enters a new house, so does a creature put on successive bodies.
verses.bhavadeepa: वस्तुतस्त्ववध्य एव आत्मा देहस्तु शालावदनात्मा तेन देहेन देहे निहते नात्मा हन्ता वा वध्यो वेत्याह- अवध्य इत्यादिना ॥५६॥

verses.sanskrit: देहान्पुराणानुत्सृज्य नवान्संप्रतिपद्यते । एवं मृत्युमुखं प्राहुर्जना ये तत्त्वदर्शिनः ॥५८॥
verses.english: Leaving behind decrepit bodies, a creature acquires new forms. People gifted with true insight consider this change as death.
